_comment: Full deck-spec schema. The build_deck.py script consumes this. Top-level fields: title, audience, aspect, template, layout_map, palette, slide_numbers, slides[].
title: ProjectX Migration — Board Update
_aspect_comment: 16:9 (default), 4:3, or 16:10. Ignored when `template` is set — the template's own slide size wins.
_template_comment: Set `template` to a brand .pptx/.potx and the deck inherits its masters, theme fonts, colors and slide size. Relative paths resolve against this spec file. Discover the layout names with: python3 scripts/build_deck.py --list-layouts brand.potx — then map each logical layout to one. Any logical layout left out of the map falls back to the deck's own built-in design.
